compatibilityFindings.notClaimed: Not evidence that the original course is wrong; its opening size and ranges may differ.

compatibilityFindings.fact: Source says QJ among worse continuing candidates; user chart QJs raises 100% and QJo calls 100%.
compatibilityFindings.result: Coarse rank labels cannot be expanded to all suit classes with the same prior.
